answer_1.quote: In this work we develop and evaluate an NLG‑chatbot that generates insights explanation by combining graphics and text...
datasets: Simulated diet diary (2 weeks of logged meals)

answer_4.quote: To assess the effectiveness of this approach, we run a human evaluation in which we compare our chatbot with traditional diet apps.
answer_4.guideline: Participants used the assigned tool to answer a 10‑point quiz about diet insights and then rated the tool on several Likert‑5 scale questions (e.g., usefulness for finding diet problems, speed of use).
